This record contains the supplementary life-cycle inventory and life-cycle impact assessment datasets supporting the study “Future climate impacts of European battery waste management: a scenario-based assessment using prospective MFA and LCA.” The datasets cover European battery waste management in the EU27+4 under Business As Usual (BAU), Recovery (REC), and Circularity (CIR) scenarios for 2020, 2030, 2040, and 2050.
